# Suite page: features grouped by repo, diffs per repo

## What to build

A suite can now span several git repos: `suite.json` has `repos[]` (`name`, `root`, `startingCommit`, `startBranch?`, `applied?`), each feature has `repo` (the name of its repo entry), every repo has its own `suite/<rid>` branch (the same name in each), and a multi-repo suite's integration worktrees are `<suiteDir>/e2e/workspace/<name>`. The suite page (`graph-execution suite --web`) still assumes one repo: the server computes every diff in one `repo` (`src/suite/server.ts:235`, `opts.review?.repo ?? path.resolve(suiteDir, "..", "..")`), and the graph draws feature boxes with no notion of repo.

This task makes the page work for multi-repo suites:

- **Diffs per repo.** `suiteChangeSources` (`src/suite/changes.ts:46`) computes each node's change source in the right repo: a feature's task, fixer and merge nodes in that feature's repo; the suite branch history (`@merge/<feature>`, `@integration/<feature>`) per repo; `@e2e-fixer` and `@apply` across repos. A change source can now be a list of per-repo ranges; the node's file list and file diffs prefix each path with `<name>/`.
- **Graph grouped by repo.** In a multi-repo suite, the page draws a label with the repo name above each group of feature boxes (features ordered by repo, then as today), and the `@apply` node's title is `apply → <n> repos`. A single-repo suite renders exactly as today (no label).
- **The page JSON** gains `repos: { name, root, startBranch?, applied? }[]` (from `suite.json`) and each feature's `repo`.

The human review panel is a separate task; leave its endpoints as they are.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/suite/changes.ts` (whole file, 126 lines) — `ChangeSource`, `suiteChangeSources(repo, suiteDir, suite, runs)`, `changesOf`, `allChangesOf`
- `src/suite/server.ts` (lines 25–60) — `SuiteServerOptions`
- `src/suite/server.ts` (lines 228–260) — `repo` fallback, `readRun`, the graphs cache
- `src/suite/server.ts` (lines 370–440) — the state endpoint that calls `suiteChangeSources` (line 382) and the per-node file endpoints (lines 404–431: `gitFileLines(source.repo, ...)`, `finalFileDiff(source.repo, ...)`, `worktreeFileDiff`)
- `src/web/assets/suitepage.js` (lines 136–184) — `buildModel(d)`: one box per feature in `boxes`, the e2e and apply nodes
- `src/web/assets/suitepage.js` (lines 186–280) — `layout(m)` and `renderGraph(d)`: how boxes are placed and drawn
- `src/suite/page.html` and `src/web/assets/graph.css` — box and label styles (reuse an existing small label class; check `graph.css` for the box title style)
- `src/suite/server.test.ts` — server tests that build a suite folder by hand and fetch the JSON
- `src/suite/web-e2e.test.ts` — browser-level test of the suite page
- `TESTING.md` — how to run a suite with `--web` and the fake provider to look at the page; the user requires looking at UI changes yourself (use `agent-browser` if available)

## Patterns to follow

**ChangeSource union (extend it):**
```ts
// src/suite/changes.ts:15
export type ChangeSource =
  | { kind: "range"; repo: string; from: string; to: string; only?: string[] }
  | { kind: "live"; worktree: string; base: string; only?: string[] };
```
Add `| { kind: "multi"; parts: { name: string; source: ChangeSource }[] }`. `changesOf` of a `multi` source concatenates each part's file list with paths prefixed `<name>/`; the file endpoints split the requested path on its first `/` to find the part and strip the prefix before calling `finalFileDiff` / `gitFileLines` / `worktreeFileDiff`.

**Page code style:** plain browser JS, no framework, small functions, `const`, string concatenation as in `buildModel`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/suite/changes.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `suiteChangeSources(suiteDir, suite, runs)` (drop the `repo` parameter; get it from `suite.repos` and `feature.repo`). Task, fixer and gate-fixer sources use the feature's repo root. The suite-branch walk (lines 69–98) runs once per repo with that repo's `startingCommit` and `suite/<rid>` head, over that repo's merged features. `@e2e-fixer` and `@apply`: with one repo, today's single `range`; with several, a `multi` source with one part per repo that has a range. `conflicts` keys are unchanged (feature names are unique).
- **IMPLEMENT**: `changesOf` / `allChangesOf` handle `multi` as described.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/suite`

### UPDATE `src/suite/server.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: stop using a single `repo` for change sources; call the new `suiteChangeSources(suiteDir, suite, runs)`. The file endpoints resolve `multi` parts. The state JSON includes `repos` and each feature's `repo`. Keep `opts.review.repo` only for the human review endpoints.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/suite/server.test.ts`

### UPDATE `src/web/assets/suitepage.js` (and `src/web/assets/graph.css` if a style is needed)

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `buildModel`, when `d.repos && d.repos.length > 1`, order `d.features` by repo (in `d.repos` order) and give each box `repo: f.repo`; `layout`/`renderGraph` draw one repo label above the first box of each repo group. `@apply` title: `"apply → " + d.repos.length + " repos"` when the suite merges and every repo has a `startBranch`, else `"result branches"`. Single-repo: unchanged.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web src/suite/web-e2e.test.ts`, then look at the page yourself (see TESTING.md: build, two temp repos, `node dist/cli.js suite --feature ... --feature ... --provider fake --web` from a third temp folder)

### UPDATE tests

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `src/suite/server.test.ts`, a hand-built two-repo suite (two temp repos with `suite/<rid>` and a feature branch merged in each): the state JSON has both `repos`, the `@merge/<feature>` change of each feature lists that feature's file, and `@apply` lists `a/<file>` and `b/<file>`; fetching the diff of `b/<file>` from `@apply` returns that file's diff.
- **IMPLEMENT**: in `src/suite/web-e2e.test.ts` (or a new case there), a two-repo suite page shows both repo names as labels.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/suite`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every node of a multi-repo suite shows the files it changed in its own repo; `@apply` and `@e2e-fixer` list files of all repos, prefixed by repo name, and their diffs open
- [ ] Feature boxes are grouped under repo labels in a multi-repo suite
- [ ] The page JSON has `repos[]` and each feature's `repo`
- [ ] A single-repo suite's page and JSON are unchanged apart from the added fields
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx eslint .`, `npx vitest run src/suite src/web` pass

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/suite src/web
npm run build
```
